title: luma calycosema
intro: Luma calycosema, commonly known as Chilean boxwood, is a flowering plant species native to South America, belonging to the Myrtaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. Luma calycosema's therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of Luma calycosema include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
